exposure: Doppler ultrasound findings (umbilical artery PI, uterine artery PI, middle cerebral artery PI, absence/reversal of end-diastolic velocities, arterial blood flow redistribution)
cohort: The study included 156 pregnant women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) in their second or third trimester.
finding: The study observed specific Doppler abnormalities, including umbilical artery PI >95th percentile and the absence or reversal of end-diastolic velocities, indicating fetal circulation concerns in GDM pregnancies.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery analysis showed a higher rate of vaginal deliveries compared to cesarean sections.
cross-section timing: Biweekly Doppler ultrasound examinations were performed from 24 weeks of gestation until delivery.
gest_age: From 24 weeks of gestation (participants were in their second or third trimester)
